_comment: Who may use what on the admin and approval pages, so the browser asks only for what it would be given (WORKORDER-approvalLooseEnds-112126 L4, L6, L7). The browser only decides whether to SHOW and ASK; every endpoint still decides from the role itself and refuses anyone else. Held equal to the server by server/test/account-approval-browser-rules.test.js.
_approverRoleList: a copy of server/lib/user-profile-rules.json approverRoleList: who may see and decide account applications.
_adminRoleList: the roles every admin-only endpoint behind the /admin tools allows (getValidator(['admin', 'super']) in admin-*, manifest-*, oauth-admin-* endpoints; raterStore ADMIN_ROLE_LIST for the Mapping Survey).
_roleListNameByToolName: per /admin tool (pages/admin.vue TOOL_NAME_LIST, every one listed): the role list above whose roles may use it, or anySignedIn for a tool that makes no admin-only request. A tool the signed-in user may not use is not shown, not mounted, and asks for nothing.
